verdict.rationale: Postman documents post-response test scripts for validating API responses, including in CI/CD via the Postman CLI. Its Playwright integration also validates captured API calls against Postman Collections, which is the closest documented contract-like check. Spec Hub and governance checks only lint the specifications themselves. Missing for 10: documented validation of live responses against an OpenAPI/spec contract, explicit drift detection or reporting, and independent hands-on corroboration.
